```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load, include = FALSE}
suppressMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(posterior)
})
source("./src/functions/paths.R")
source("./src/functions/hierarchical_mcmc_fns.R")
source("./src/functions/cluster_fns.R")
source("./src/functions/plot_mcmc_diagnostics.R")   # simulate_hierarchical_priors()
source("./src/functions/posterior_summary_fns.R")
source("./src/functions/brms_int_cluster_fns.R")    # prepare_brms_full_data()
source("./src/functions/pipeline_fns.R")            # mcmc_variants(), mcmc_variant_dir()
source("./src/functions/numbers_fns.R")             # num(), num_ci(), write_numbers()
source("./src/functions/data_stream_fns.R")         # data_stream_counts(), shared with plots.R
source("./src/functions/tex_table_fns.R")           # shared table format: tex_float_table(), tex_long_table()

SE            <- params$rdt_sensitivity
GRID_OUT_DIR  <- DIR_GRID
MCMC_OUT_DIR  <- rdt_sensitivity_dir(DIR_MCMC, SE)
PPI_DIR       <- file.path(MCMC_OUT_DIR, "posterior_predictive")
SITE_PREV_DIR <- DIR_STRUCTURE
REG_DIR       <- DIR_REGRESSION
OUT_DIR       <- RESULTS_DIR
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# --- formatting ------------------------------------------------------------
fmt <- function(x, d = 1) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
ci  <- function(m, lo, hi, d = 2) sprintf("%s (%s--%s)", fmt(m, d), fmt(lo, d), fmt(hi, d))
rng <- function(x, d = 2) sprintf("%s--%s", fmt(min(x), d), fmt(max(x), d))
int <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
# Numbers that open a sentence are written as words ("Six of the 14 countries")
num_word <- function(x, cap = FALSE) {
  w <- if (x >= 0 && x <= 20) c("zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten",
                                "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen", "fifteen", "sixteen", "seventeen",
                                "eighteen", "nineteen", "twenty")[x + 1] else int(x)
  if (cap) paste0(toupper(substring(w, 1, 1)), substring(w, 2)) else w
}

# Problems found while filling (stale inputs, numbers the current model can't give)
checks <- character(0)
note <- function(...) checks <<- c(checks, sprintf(...))
stale <- function(file, than, what) {
  if (file.exists(file) && file.exists(than) && file.mtime(file) < file.mtime(than)) {
    note("%s (%s, %s) is OLDER than %s (%s) -- rerun it so the numbers match the current fit.",
         what, basename(file), format(file.mtime(file), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
         basename(than), format(file.mtime(than), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
  }
}
```

This document recomputes every number in the Results section from the current pipeline outputs and prints the section with the numbers filled in. Report variant: **RDT sensitivity `r SE`** (`r MCMC_OUT_DIR`).

```{r data-stream}

conc <- fread(file.path(DIR_PULL, "dhs_mis_concordance.csv"))[sub_region == "National"]
paired <- unique(conc[, .(country, survey_year)])
paired <- paired[!(country %in% c('Madagascar', 'Kenya'))]

N_reg_individuals <- nobs(reg_fit)

if (nrow(reg_data) != N_reg_individuals) {

       int(nrow(reg_data)), int(N_reg_individuals))
```

```{r regression}
# ---- 2. Regression: FPR / FDR ---------------------------------------------
cov  <- readRDS(file.path(REG_DIR, "fpfn_by_covariate.RDS"))
grid <- readRDS(file.path(REG_DIR, "fpfn_full_grid.RDS"))
stale(file.path(REG_DIR, "fpfn_by_covariate.RDS"), file.path(REG_DIR, "fit_brms_int_full_local.RDS"),
      "Regression FPR/FDR summaries (step 2 Section B)")
FPR <- "P(RDT+ | microscopy-)"
FDR <- "P(microscopy- | RDT+)"
eff <- function(pattern, oc) cov[grepl(pattern, covariate, fixed = TRUE) & outcome == oc]
sig <- function(r) r$diff_lo > 0 | r$diff_hi < 0
eff_txt <- function(r, sign = 1) ci(sign * r$diff_mean, if (sign > 0) r$diff_lo else -r$diff_hi,
                                    if (sign > 0) r$diff_hi else -r$diff_lo)

fpr_prev_hi  <- eff("Prevalence: >20% vs <10%", FPR)
fpr_prev_mid <- eff("Prevalence: 10-20% vs <10%", FPR)
fpr_high_del <- eff("PfHRP2: High vs Slight", FPR)
fpr_high_sig <- fpr_high_del[sig(fpr_high_del)]
fdr_high_del <- eff("PfHRP2: High vs Slight", FDR)
fdr_med_del  <- eff("PfHRP2: Medium vs Slight", FDR)

bin_names <- c(Fever = "Fever", SMC = "SMC", Care = "Formal care/ACT",
               Timing = "During/after peak season", Age = "Age (+1 year)")
bin_fpr <- rbindlist(lapply(names(bin_names), function(k) eff(bin_names[[k]], FPR)[, key := k]))
bin_fdr <- rbindlist(lapply(names(bin_names), function(k) eff(bin_names[[k]], FDR)[, key := k]))
if (!all(sig(bin_fpr))) note("Not every binary covariate significantly changes the FPR now: %s.",
                             paste(bin_fpr[!sig(bin_fpr), key], collapse = ", "))
bin_fpr <- bin_fpr[order(-diff_mean)]

# Strata extremes. tex_prev(): "<10%" -> "$<$10\%" etc. (an unescaped % starts
# a LaTeX comment and would silently cut the rest of the line).
tex_prev <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("%", "\\%", x, fixed = TRUE)   # fixed = TRUE: replacement is literal, so one backslash
  x <- sub("^>=?", "$>$", x)
  sub("^<", "$<$", x)
}
grid_lab <- function(r) {
  paste(c(sprintf("%s prevalence", tex_prev(r$sr_rdt_cat)),
          sprintf("%s deletion risk", tolower(sub("Marginal/Moderate", "medium", r$hrp2_risk))),
          if (r$has_smc == 1) "SMC area" else "no SMC",
          if (r$during_or_after_peak == 1) "survey during or after peak rainfall" else "before peak rainfall",
          if (r$care_or_act == 1) "received care" else "no care",
          if (r$fever == 1) "reported fever" else "no fever"), collapse = ", ")
}
fpr_grid <- grid[outcome == FPR]; fdr_grid <- grid[outcome == FDR]
fpr_min <- fpr_grid[which.min(p_mean)]; fpr_max <- fpr_grid[which.max(p_mean)]
fdr_min <- fdr_grid[which.min(p_mean)]; fdr_max <- fdr_grid[which.max(p_mean)]

# Average marginal effects (fpfn_ame.RDS; method in results/ame_method.txt),
# percentage points
ame <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(REG_DIR, "fpfn_ame.RDS")))
stale(file.path(REG_DIR, "fpfn_ame.RDS"), file.path(REG_DIR, "fit_brms_int_full_local.RDS"),
      "Average marginal effects (step 2 Section B)")
ame_key <- c("Prevalence: 10-20% vs <10%" = "prevmid", "Prevalence: >20% vs <10%" = "prevhi",
             "PfHRP2: Medium vs Slight" = "meddel", "PfHRP2: High vs Slight" = "highdel",
             "Fever" = "fever", "Formal care/ACT" = "care", "SMC" = "smc",
             "During/after peak season" = "timing", "Age (+1 year)" = "age")
stopifnot(setequal(ame$covariate, names(ame_key)))
ame[, out_key := fifelse(outcome == FPR, "fpr", "fdr")]
# In the filled text the AMEs are \nm{} keys into numbers.tex (registered in
# the numbers chunk); key = FALSE gives the number itself, for keys holding text.
ame_ci <- function(o, k, key = TRUE) {
  if (key) return(sprintf("\\nm{reg.ame.%s.%s.ci}", o, k))
  r <- ame[out_key == o & ame_key[covariate] == k]; sprintf("%s (%s--%s)", fmt(r$mean, 1), fmt(r$lo, 1), fmt(r$hi, 1))
}
# Non-interacting covariates for FPR, largest first: "fever (...), SMC area (...), ... and survey timing (...)"
ame_bin_lab <- c(fever = "fever", care = "care receipt", smc = "SMC area", age = "age", timing = "survey timing")
ame_bin <- ame[out_key == "fpr" & ame_key[covariate] %in% names(ame_bin_lab)][order(-abs(mean))]
ame_bin_list <- function(key) {
  x <- sprintf("%s (%s%s)", ame_bin_lab[ame_key[ame_bin$covariate]],
               vapply(ame_key[ame_bin$covariate], function(k) ame_ci("fpr", k, key), ""),
               fifelse(ame_key[ame_bin$covariate] == "age", " for a one-year increase", ""))
  paste(paste(head(x, -1), collapse = ", "), "and", tail(x, 1))
}
ame_bin_txt <- ame_bin_list(key = TRUE)
if (!all(ame_bin$lo > 0)) note("Not every non-interacting covariate now significantly increases the FPR (AME); the text says they all do.")

# Country maps (src/plots.R PLOT_FPR_FDR_MAPS): sub-regional rates in each
# country's most recent survey, summarised by country, with national RDT
# prevalence (survey-weighted, all RDT-tested children, not only those with LM too)
map_csv <- file.path(REG_DIR, "fpr_fdr_by_subregion.csv")   # written by src/plots.R (PLOT_FPR_FDR_MAPS)
stale(map_csv, file.path(REG_DIR, "fit_brms_int_full_local.RDS"), "Country FPR/FDR maps (plots.R PLOT_FPR_FDR_MAPS)")
map_sr <- fread(map_csv)
rdt_nat <- fread(file.path(SITE_PREV_DIR, "dhs_mis_individual_hrp2.csv"))[!is.na(rdt_result)][
  , .(rdt_prev = 100 * weighted.mean(rdt_result == 1, fifelse(is.na(sample_weight), 1, sample_weight))), by = .(country, survey_year)]
map_nat <- merge(map_sr[, .(fpr_mean = mean(fpr), fpr_min = min(fpr), fpr_max = max(fpr),
                            fdr_mean = mean(fdr), fdr_min = min(fdr), fdr_max = max(fdr)), by = .(country, survey_year)],
                 rdt_nat, by = c("country", "survey_year"), all.x = TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyNA(map_nat$rdt_prev))
map_nat <- merge(map_nat, region, by = "country", all.x = TRUE)
map_nat[, key := gsub("[^a-z]", "", tolower(iconv(country, to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")))]
map_nat[, rdt_cat := fifelse(rdt_prev < 10, "$<$10\\%", fifelse(rdt_prev <= 20, "10--20\\%", "$>$20\\%"))]
map_ext <- lapply(c(fpr = "fpr", fdr = "fdr"), function(o) list(min = map_sr[which.min(get(o))], max = map_sr[which.max(get(o))]))
map_d <- function(x) if (x < 1) 2 else 1   # two decimals below 1%
# "\nm{reg.map.fpr.min.pci} in \nm{...region}, \nm{...country} (\nm{...year} survey)"
map_ext_txt <- function(o, s) {
  k <- sprintf("reg.map.%s.%s", o, s)
  sprintf("\\nm{%1$s.pci} in \\nm{%1$s.region}, \\nm{%1$s.country} (\\nm{%1$s.year} survey)", k)
}
# Example countries named in the text (lowest and a high national FPR)
map_eg <- lapply(c(lo = "Madagascar", hi = "Togo"), function(ctry) {
  r <- map_nat[country == ctry]
  if (nrow(r) != 1) stop("No country map for ", ctry, "; change the example countries in the regression chunk.")
  r
})
# West vs East: mean of the country mean FPRs in WCA vs ESA
fpr_wca <- map_nat[africa_region == "WCA", mean(fpr_mean)]; fpr_esa <- map_nat[africa_region == "ESA", mean(fpr_mean)]
```

```{r calibration-data}
ll      <- readRDS(file.path(GRID_OUT_DIR, log_lik_file(SE)))
mis     <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(SITE_PREV_DIR, "matched_site_mis_prevalence.RDS")))
fit_sites <- unique(ll$best_by_name1[, .(iso, name_1)])
N_sites    <- nrow(fit_sites)
fit_isos   <- unique(fit_sites$iso)
N_cal_countries <- length(fit_isos)
cal_obs <- mis[iso3c %in% fit_isos & !is.na(pfpr_rdt_num) & !is.na(pfpr_lm_num)]
N_cal_surveys <- uniqueN(cal_obs[, .(iso3c, year)])
cal_years     <- range(cal_obs$year)
N_deletion_from_review <- ll$deletion_info_by_iso[source == "file", .N]

# RDT/LM: per paired observation (deduplicated on value, as in plots.R's
# build_mis_scatter()), and per-country slope through the origin
pairs <- unique(cal_obs[, .(iso = iso3c, year, rdt = pfpr_rdt_num / pfpr_rdt_denom, lm = pfpr_lm_num / pfpr_lm_denom)])
ratio <- pairs[lm > 0, rdt / lm]
COUNTRY <- c(BDI = "Burundi", BEN = "Benin", BFA = "Burkina Faso", CIV = "C\\^ote d'Ivoire", GHA = "Ghana",
             GIN = "Guinea", KEN = "Kenya", LBR = "Liberia", MDG = "Madagascar", MLI = "Mali", MWI = "Malawi",
             NGA = "Nigeria", RWA = "Rwanda", SEN = "Senegal", TGO = "Togo", UGA = "Uganda")
slopes <- pairs[, .(slope = coef(lm(rdt ~ 0 + lm))[[1]]), by = iso][, country := COUNTRY[iso]][order(-slope)]
below1 <- slopes[round(slope, 1) < 1]
```

```{r convergence}
# ---- 4. MCMC convergence ------------------------
mcmc_combined <- readRDS(file.path(MCMC_OUT_DIR, "mcmc_combined.RDS"))
mcmc_inputs   <- readRDS(file.path(MCMC_OUT_DIR, "mcmc_inputs.RDS"))
fit_se <- if (is.null(mcmc_inputs$rdt_sensitivity)) 1 else mcmc_inputs$rdt_sensitivity
post   <- load_hierarchical_posterior(MCMC_OUT_DIR, GRID_OUT_DIR, mcmc_combined = mcmc_combined)
n_chains <- length(mcmc_combined$chains); n_iter <- mcmc_combined$chains[[1]]$n_iter
keep <- setdiff(names(mcmc_combined$chains[[1]]$samples), c("iter", "chain", ".chain", ".iteration", ".draw"))
arr <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_iter, n_chains, length(keep)), dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, keep))
for (k in seq_len(n_chains)) arr[, k, ] <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(mcmc_combined$chains[[k]]$samples)[, keep])
conv <- as.data.table(posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(arr), "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail"))   # posterior_summary_fns.R masks summarise_draws()
```

```{r convergence-summary}
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(fit_se, SE))) {
  note("The MCMC fit in %s was run with RDT sensitivity %.2f, not the requested %.2f.", MCMC_OUT_DIR, fit_se, SE)
}
site_names <- post$site_names
pop_conv  <- conv[variable %in% c("mu_d", "sigma_d")]
site_conv <- conv[grepl("^log_d_[0-9]+$|^log_eir_[0-9]+$", variable)]
site_conv[, site := site_names[as.integer(sub("^log_d_|^log_eir_", "", variable))]]
N_site_pars   <- nrow(site_conv)
N_rhat_ok     <- site_conv[rhat <= 1.01, .N]
N_ess_ok      <- site_conv[ess_bulk >= 400, .N]
flagged       <- unique(site_conv[rhat > 1.01 | ess_bulk < 400 | ess_tail < 400, site])
ps <- mcmc_combined$pooled_samples
flag_cor <- sapply(flagged, function(s) {
  i <- match(s, site_names); abs(cor(ps[[paste0("log_d_", i)]], ps[[paste0("log_eir_", i)]]))
})
grid_pts <- ll$by_name1_grid_point
edge_hl  <- range(grid_pts$hrp2_scale); edge_eir <- range(grid_pts$eir)
flag_edge <- ll$best_by_name1[paste(iso, name_1, sep = "_") %in% flagged &
                                (hrp2_scale %in% edge_hl | eir %in% edge_eir)]
worst <- site_conv[order(-rhat)][1]
```

```{r posterior}
# ---- 5. Posterior estimates -----------------------------------------------
pop   <- get_population_parameters(post)
mu_hl <- pop[parameter == "halflife_pop_median"]
sig_d <- ps$sigma_d
newsite <- predict_unobserved_site(post, seed = 1L)$draws$halflife
new_q   <- quantile(newsite, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975))
eir_med <- apply(as.matrix(ps[, paste0("eir_", seq_along(site_names)), with = FALSE]), 2, median)

priors_sim <- simulate_hierarchical_priors(mcmc_inputs$log_eir_bounds, mcmc_inputs$log_d_bounds, priors = mcmc_inputs$priors)
prior_mu_hl <- priors_sim$mu_d_natural * log(2)
prior_centre <- exp(mcmc_inputs$priors$mu_d_mean) * log(2)

site_hl <- summarise_site_parameters(post, by = "site", weights = params$agg_weights)
site_hl[, country := COUNTRY[sub("_.*", "", site)]]
hl_min <- site_hl[which.min(halflife_median)]; hl_max <- site_hl[which.max(halflife_median)]
# Sites outside the unobserved-site 95% predictive interval, either side
outside <- site_hl[halflife_median > new_q[3] | halflife_median < new_q[2]]
n_above <- outside[halflife_median > new_q[3], .N]; n_below <- outside[halflife_median < new_q[2], .N]
outside[, side := fifelse(halflife_median > new_q[3], "above", "below")]
outside_by_country <- outside[, .(N = .N, above = sum(side == "above"), below = sum(side == "below")), by = country][order(-N, country)]
outside_by_country[, side_txt := fifelse(below == 0, "all above", fifelse(above == 0, "all below",
                                                                           sprintf("%d above, %d below", above, below)))]
country_hl <- summarise_site_parameters(post, by = "country", weights = params$agg_weights)
country_hl[, country_name := COUNTRY[iso]]
all_below <- site_hl[, .(all_below = all(halflife_median < prior_centre)), by = country][all_below == TRUE, country]
low_c <- country_hl[country_name %in% all_below][order(halflife_median)]
```

```{r ppc}
# ---- 6. Posterior predictive coverage --------------------------------------
ppi_path <- file.path(PPI_DIR, "posterior_predictive_summary.RDS")
ppc <- NULL
if (!file.exists(ppi_path)) {
  note("No posterior_predictive_summary.RDS for this fit -- run step 4 (src/4_sample_posterior/sample_posterior.R).")
} else if (file.mtime(ppi_path) < file.mtime(file.path(MCMC_OUT_DIR, "mcmc_combined.RDS"))) {
  note("posterior_predictive_summary.RDS is older than this fit's mcmc_combined.RDS -- coverage not reported; rerun step 4 (src/4_sample_posterior/sample_posterior.R).")
} else {
  ppi <- as.data.table(readRDS(ppi_path))
  joint <- all(c("tp_lo", "fp_lo", "fn_lo", "tn_lo") %in% names(ppi))
  if (joint) {
    obs <- unique(mis[!is.na(joint_n) & joint_n > 0, .(iso = iso3c, name_1, year,
            tp = joint_tp / joint_n, fp = joint_fp / joint_n, fn = joint_fn / joint_n, tn = joint_tn / joint_n)])
    chk <- merge(obs, ppi, by = c("iso", "name_1", "year"))
    cells <- c(TP = "tp", FP = "fp", FN = "fn", TN = "tn")
  } else {
    note("Posterior predictive summary has no TP/FP/FN/TN cells (submitted before joint = TRUE) -- reporting RDT/LM coverage.")
    obs <- unique(mis[, .(iso = iso3c, name_1, year, rdt = pfpr_rdt_num / pfpr_rdt_denom, lm = pfpr_lm_num / pfpr_lm_denom)])
    chk <- merge(obs, ppi[, .(iso, name_1, year, rdt_lo = hrp2_lo, rdt_hi = hrp2_hi, lm_lo, lm_hi)], by = c("iso", "name_1", "year"))
    cells <- c(RDT = "rdt", LM = "lm")
  }
  for (cl in cells) chk[, (paste0(cl, "_in")) := get(cl) >= get(paste0(cl, "_lo")) & get(cl) <= get(paste0(cl, "_hi"))]
  ppc_all <- sapply(cells, function(cl) 100 * mean(chk[[paste0(cl, "_in")]], na.rm = TRUE))
  ppc_cty <- chk[, lapply(.SD, function(x) 100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), by = iso, .SDcols = paste0(cells, "_in")]
  setnames(ppc_cty, paste0(cells, "_in"), names(cells))
  ppc_cty[, country := COUNTRY[iso]][, mean_cov := rowMeans(.SD), .SDcols = names(cells)]
  ppc <- list(joint = joint, all = ppc_all, by_country = ppc_cty[order(mean_cov)], cells = cells)

  # Marginal RDT (TP + FP) and LM (TP + FN) coverage from our model, and RDT
  # coverage under the Wu et al. RDT:microscopy relationship applied to the
  # same LM draws (step 4 Section I). Same joint-tested children as above.
  marg_cols <- c(RDT = "rdtj", LM = "lmj", `RDT (Wu et al.)` = "rdtwu")
  if (joint && all(paste0(marg_cols, "_lo") %in% names(chk))) {
    chk[, `:=`(rdt_obs = tp + fp, lm_obs = tp + fn)]
    obs_col <- c(rdtj = "rdt_obs", lmj = "lm_obs", rdtwu = "rdt_obs")
    for (m in marg_cols) chk[, (paste0(m, "_in")) := get(obs_col[[m]]) >= get(paste0(m, "_lo")) & get(obs_col[[m]]) <= get(paste0(m, "_hi"))]
    ppc$marg_all <- setNames(sapply(marg_cols, function(m) 100 * mean(chk[[paste0(m, "_in")]], na.rm = TRUE)), marg_cols)
    ppc$marg_cty <- chk[, lapply(.SD, function(x) 100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), by = iso, .SDcols = paste0(marg_cols, "_in")]
    setnames(ppc$marg_cty, paste0(marg_cols, "_in"), marg_cols)
    ppc$marg_cty[, country := COUNTRY[iso]]
    # Numerator / denominator: survey-years inside the interval / survey-years compared
    kn <- function(x) sprintf("%d/%d (%s%%)", sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!is.na(x)), fmt(100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 0))
    ppc$marg_kn  <- chk[, lapply(.SD, kn), by = iso, .SDcols = paste0(marg_cols, "_in")]
    setnames(ppc$marg_kn, paste0(marg_cols, "_in"), marg_cols)
    ppc$marg_kn[, country := COUNTRY[iso]]
    ppc$marg_k <- setNames(sapply(marg_cols, function(m) sum(chk[[paste0(m, "_in")]], na.rm = TRUE)), marg_cols)
    ppc$marg_n <- setNames(sapply(marg_cols, function(m) sum(!is.na(chk[[paste0(m, "_in")]]))), marg_cols)
    wu_sd_path <- file.path(PPI_DIR, "wu_residual_sd.RDS")
    ppc$wu_sd <- if (file.exists(wu_sd_path)) readRDS(wu_sd_path) else NULL
  } else if (joint) {
    note("No marginal RDT/LM or Wu et al. intervals in posterior_predictive_summary.RDS -- rerun step 4 Section I (AGG_POST = TRUE).")
  }
}
```

```{r emulator-near-peak}
# ---- 7. Emulator fit near the peak -----------------------------------------
# Step 3b's leave-one-out RMSE over the grid points within 3 log-likelihood
# units of each site's best grid point (loo_cv_emulators(): rmse_near); 3 units
# ~ the 95% joint region for two parameters (chi-squared(2) 95% critical value
# 5.99 / 2), i.e. where the posterior sits. Sites with rmse_near above
# EMU_FLAG_RMSE are flagged (identify_poor_loo_sites()). EMU_POOR_ISO:
# countries whose near-peak error is reported separately in the text
# (Rwanda: simulation noise in the likelihood surface; Senegal: raised error
# across the whole country).
source("./src/functions/emulator_fns.R")
NEAR_PEAK_TEXT <- 3
EMU_FLAG_RMSE  <- formals(identify_poor_loo_sites)$near_peak_rmse_threshold
EMU_POOR_ISO   <- c("RWA", "SEN")
emu_val_path <- file.path(rdt_sensitivity_dir(DIR_EMULATOR, SE), "emulator_validation.rds")
emu_val   <- readRDS(emu_val_path)
if (is.null(emu_val$loo$rmse_near)) stop("emulator_validation.rds predates the near-peak flag -- rerun step 3b Section D.")
near_peak <- emu_val$loo[, .(site, iso = sub("_.*", "", site), n = n_near, rmse = rmse_near)]
poor_emulator <- emu_val$poor_sites
# LM prevalence in each poorly emulated country's most recent survey (pooled
# over its sites), for the "low transmission" clause
emu_poor_lm <- cal_obs[iso3c %in% EMU_POOR_ISO][, .SD[year == max(year)], by = iso3c][
  , .(year = year[1], lm = sum(pfpr_lm_num) / sum(pfpr_lm_denom)), by = iso3c]
```

```{r sensitivity-fits}
# ---- 8. Sensitivity fits: RDT sensitivity and sigma_d prior SD -------------
# Prior and posterior summaries for every fit, used in the text and in the two
# prior/posterior tables. q3() = median, 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles.
q3 <- function(x) quantile(x, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975))
fit_post <- function(rdt_se, sd, full = FALSE) {
  d <- mcmc_variant_dir(rdt_se, sd)
  m <- readRDS(file.path(d, "mcmc_combined.RDS")); s <- m$pooled_samples
  n_site <- sum(grepl("^eir_[0-9]+$", names(s)))
  out <- list(mu  = q3(log_d_to_halflife(s$mu_d)), sd = q3(s$sigma_d),
              eir = q3(apply(as.matrix(s[, paste0("eir_", seq_len(n_site)), with = FALSE]), 2, median)))
  if (!full) return(out)
  # sigma_d prior-SD fits: priors and unobserved-site predictions as well
  inp <- readRDS(file.path(d, "mcmc_inputs.RDS"))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(inp$priors$sigma_d_prior_sd, sd)))
  pr  <- simulate_hierarchical_priors(inp$log_eir_bounds, inp$log_d_bounds, priors = inp$priors)
  pv  <- load_hierarchical_posterior(d, GRID_OUT_DIR, mcmc_combined = m)
  nq  <- q3(predict_unobserved_site(pv, seed = 1L)$draws$halflife)
  shl <- summarise_site_parameters(pv, by = "site", weights = params$agg_weights)
  c(out, list(pr_mu = q3(pr$mu_d_natural * log(2)), pr_sd = q3(pr$sigma_d), pr_new = q3(pr$d * log(2)),
              pr_eir = q3(pr$eir), new = nq,
              n_out = shl[halflife_median < nq[2] | halflife_median > nq[3], .N], n_site = nrow(shl)))
}
se_post   <- lapply(RDT_SENSITIVITY_OPTIONS, fit_post, sd = SIGMA_D_PRIOR_SD_MAIN)
SIGMA_SDS <- c(SIGMA_D_PRIOR_SD_MAIN, SIGMA_D_PRIOR_SD_OPTIONS)
sig_fit   <- lapply(SIGMA_SDS, function(sd) fit_post(RDT_SENSITIVITY_MAIN, sd, full = TRUE))
```

```{r table-sites, results = "asis"}
site_tab <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(site_names), function(i) {
  d <- ps[[paste0("d_", i)]] * log(2); e <- ps[[paste0("eir_", i)]]
  data.table(site = site_names[i], iso = sub("_.*", "", site_names[i]), name_1 = sub("^[A-Z]{3}_", "", site_names[i]),
             eir = tab_ci(quantile(e, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975)), TAB_DP[["eir"]]),
             halflife = tab_ci(quantile(d, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975)), TAB_DP[["halflife"]]), halflife_med = median(d))
}))
# Red: posterior median half-life outside the 95% predictive interval for an
# unobserved site (new_q, posterior chunk)
site_tab[halflife_med < new_q[[2]] | halflife_med > new_q[[3]], halflife := sprintf("\\textcolor{red}{%s}", halflife)]
site_tab[, country := COUNTRY[iso]]
site_tab[, flag := vapply(site, function(s) {
  # One-letter codes (defined in the caption) keep the table inside the A4 text width
  f <- c(if (s %in% poor_emulator) "E", if (s %in% flagged) "C")
  if (length(f)) paste(f, collapse = ", ") else "--"
}, "")]
# Countries sorted on the plain name (the LaTeX accent in C\^ote would sort it last)
site_tab[, country_sort := gsub("\\^", "", country, fixed = TRUE)]
setorder(site_tab, country_sort, name_1)

if (is.null(ppc) || !ppc$joint) {
  note("No current joint (TP/FP/FN/TN) posterior predictive summary -- site table PPC left as --.")
} else {
  site_ppc <- melt(chk[, .(site = paste(iso, name_1, sep = "_"), year, tp_in, fp_in, fn_in, tn_in)],
                   id.vars = c("site", "year"), value.name = "inside")[!is.na(inside),
                   .(n_in = sum(inside), n_obs = .N), by = site][, ppc_pct := 100 * n_in / n_obs]
  site_tab[site_ppc, `:=`(ppc = sprintf("%d/%d (%s\\%%)", i.n_in, i.n_obs, fmt(i.ppc_pct, 0)),
                          n_in = i.n_in, n_obs = i.n_obs), on = "site"]
  p <- site_ppc$ppc_pct
  cat(sprintf("Site PPC (TP, FP, FN and TN, per survey year): median %s%% (IQR %s--%s%%); %d sites at 100%%, %d below 50%%, %d at 0%%.\n\n",
              fmt(median(p), 0), fmt(quantile(p, 0.25), 0), fmt(quantile(p, 0.75), 0), sum(p == 100), sum(p < 50), sum(p == 0)))
}
if (!"ppc" %in% names(site_tab)) site_tab[, ppc := "--"]
site_tab[is.na(ppc), ppc := "--"]

site_rows <- unlist(lapply(unique(site_tab$country), function(cn) {
  s <- site_tab[country == cn]
  # Country PPC: the same count summed over the country's sites
  cty_ppc <- if ("n_obs" %in% names(s) && any(!is.na(s$n_obs))) {
    k <- sum(s$n_in, na.rm = TRUE); n <- sum(s$n_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
    sprintf("\\textbf{%d/%d (%s\\%%)}", k, n, fmt(100 * k / n, 0))
  } else "--"
  c(tab_bold_group(sprintf("\\textbf{%s} (%d sites)", cn, nrow(s)), 5, span = 3, rest = c(cty_ppc, "")),
    sprintf("\\quad %s & %s & %s & %s & %s \\\\", tex_escape(s$name_1), s$eir, s$halflife, s$ppc, s$flag),
    if (cn != tail(unique(site_tab$country), 1)) "\\addlinespace")
}))
tab_sites <- tex_long_table(
  "l c c c l",
  "\\textbf{Site} & \\textbf{EIR} & \\textbf{Half-life (days)} & \\textbf{PPC} & \\textbf{Flag} \\\\",
  site_rows,
  sprintf("Site-level posterior median (95\\%% CrI) EIR and HRP2 half-life, RDT sensitivity %d\\%%. Half-lives in red have a posterior median outside the 95\\%% predictive interval for an unobserved site (%s--%s days). PPC = posterior predictive coverage: of the site's observed shares of children tested by both RDT and LM who were TP (RDT+/LM+), FP (RDT+/LM-), FN (RDT-/LM+) and TN (RDT-/LM-) in each MIS survey year (four per survey year), the number inside their 95\\%% posterior predictive interval; country rows (bold) sum over the country's sites. Flag: E = poor emulator fit (leave-one-out RMSE above %s log-likelihood units over grid points within %d units of the site's peak); C = poor convergence ($\\hat{R} > 1.01$ or bulk or tail ESS $<$ 400).",
          round(100 * SE), fmt(new_q[[2]]), fmt(new_q[[3]]), fmt(EMU_FLAG_RMSE, 0), NEAR_PEAK_TEXT),
  sprintf("tab:site_posteriors_%s", rdt_sensitivity_tag(SE)))
cat(sprintf("%d sites in %d countries; %d flagged for the emulator, %d for convergence; %d half-lives outside the unobserved-site interval (%s--%s days). Needs \\usepackage{longtable, booktabs, xcolor}.\n\n",
            nrow(site_tab), uniqueN(site_tab$country), sum(site_tab$site %in% poor_emulator), sum(site_tab$site %in% flagged),
```

# Table: emulator-flagged sites

```{r table-emulator-flags, results = "asis"}
# Sites flagged in step 3b (identify_poor_loo_sites()): leave-one-out RMSE
# within NEAR_PEAK_TEXT = 3 log-likelihood units of the peak above
# EMU_FLAG_RMSE (emulator-near-peak chunk). Hold-out columns come from the
# refit validation step 3b runs on the flagged sites only (20% of grid points
# held out); its near-peak RMSE uses the same 3-unit window, so sites with no
# held-out point that close to the peak show "--".
if (length(poor_emulator) == 0) {
  cat("No emulator-flagged sites for this fit -- no table written.\n")
} else {
  site_max <- ll$by_name1_grid_point[, .(ll_max = max(log_lik)), by = .(site = paste(iso, name_1, sep = "_"))]
  ho_near <- merge(emu_val$val$detail, site_max, by = "site")[ll_true >= ll_max - NEAR_PEAK_TEXT,
               .(ho_rmse_near = sqrt(mean(error^2))), by = site]
  emu_flags <- merge(emu_val$loo[site %in% poor_emulator],
                     emu_val$val$summary[, .(site, ho_rmse = rmse)], by = "site", all.x = TRUE)
  emu_flags <- merge(emu_flags, ho_near, by = "site", all.x = TRUE)
  emu_flags[, `:=`(iso = sub("_.*", "", site), name_1 = sub("^[A-Z]{3}_", "", site))]
  emu_flags[, country := COUNTRY[iso]][, country_sort := gsub("\\^", "", country, fixed = TRUE)]
  setorder(emu_flags, country_sort, name_1)

  na_fmt <- function(x, d) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", fmt(x, d))
  emu_rows <- unlist(lapply(unique(emu_flags$country), function(cn) {
    s <- emu_flags[country == cn]
    c(tab_bold_group(sprintf("\\textbf{%s} (%d of %d sites)", cn, nrow(s), site_tab[country == cn, .N]), 6),
      sprintf("\\quad %s & %s & %d & %s & %s & %s \\\\", tex_escape(s$name_1),
              fmt(s$rmse_near, 2), s$n_near, fmt(s$rmse, 2),
              na_fmt(s$ho_rmse_near, 2), na_fmt(s$ho_rmse, 2)),
      if (cn != tail(unique(emu_flags$country), 1)) "\\addlinespace")
  }))
  # Two-line headers (\makecell) keep the six columns inside the text width
  tab_emu <- tex_long_table(
    "l c c c c c",
    c(" & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Leave-one-out}} & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\textbf{Hold-out refit}} \\\\",
      "\\cmidrule(lr){2-4} \\cmidrule(l){5-6}",
      "\\textbf{Site} & \\textbf{\\makecell{RMSE\\\\near peak}} & \\textbf{\\makecell{Points\\\\near peak}} & \\textbf{RMSE} & \\textbf{\\makecell{RMSE\\\\near peak}} & \\textbf{RMSE} \\\\"),
    emu_rows,
    sprintf("Sites flagged for poor emulator performance, RDT sensitivity %d\\%% (%d of %d sites). A site was flagged when its leave-one-out RMSE over grid points within %d log-likelihood units of its best grid point (near peak) exceeded %s log-likelihood units (median across all sites %s). RMSE without qualification is over the whole grid. Flagged sites were refitted with 20\\%% of grid points held out; -- = no held-out point near the peak. RMSE is in log-likelihood units.",
            round(100 * SE), nrow(emu_flags), nrow(emu_val$loo), NEAR_PEAK_TEXT, fmt(EMU_FLAG_RMSE, 0),
            fmt(median(emu_val$loo$rmse_near), 2)),
    sprintf("tab:emulator_flags_%s", rdt_sensitivity_tag(SE)))
  cat(sprintf("%d sites flagged (near-peak LOO RMSE > %s): %s.\n\n", nrow(emu_flags), fmt(EMU_FLAG_RMSE, 0),
              paste(emu_flags$site, collapse = ", ")))
  cat("```latex\n", paste(tab_emu, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
}
```

# MCMC fitting summary

```{r mcmc-fits}
# ---- Diagnostics for every MCMC fit (main, RDT sensitivity, sigma_d prior SD)
# Per fit: sampler settings, R-hat / bulk and tail ESS for the population and
# site parameters, acceptance rates, decay-EIR posterior correlation, and the
# population half-life and sigma_d posteriors. Reads each fit's chains, so cached.
q3 <- function(x) quantile(x, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975))
mcmc_fit_summary <- function(rdt_se, sd) {
  dir <- mcmc_variant_dir(rdt_se, sd)
  if (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "mcmc_combined.RDS"))) return(NULL)
  m  <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "mcmc_combined.RDS"))
  ch <- m$chains
  keep <- grep("^(mu_d|sigma_d|log_d_[0-9]+|log_eir_[0-9]+)$", names(ch[[1]]$samples), value = TRUE)
  arr <- array(NA_real_, c(nrow(ch[[1]]$samples), length(ch), length(keep)), dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, keep))
  for (k in seq_along(ch)) arr[, k, ] <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(ch[[k]]$samples)[, keep])
  cv <- as.data.table(posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(arr), "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail"))
  pop <- cv[variable %in% c("mu_d", "sigma_d")]; st <- cv[!variable %in% c("mu_d", "sigma_d")]
  acc <- rbindlist(lapply(ch, function(c) data.table(mu = c$accept_rates$mu_d, sd = c$accept_rates$sigma_d,
                                                     decay = list(c$accept_rates$decay), eir = list(c$accept_rates$eir))))
  ps <- m$pooled_samples; n <- length(ch[[1]]$site_names)
  r  <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) cor(ps[[paste0("log_d_", i)]], ps[[paste0("log_eir_", i)]]), 0)
  list(
    rdt_sensitivity = rdt_se, sigma_d_prior_sd = sd,
    n_chains = length(ch), n_warmup = ch[[1]]$n_warmup, n_iter = ch[[1]]$n_iter, thin = ch[[1]]$thin,
    n_draws = nrow(ps), n_sites = n,
    max_rhat_pop = max(pop$rhat), min_ess_bulk_pop = min(pop$ess_bulk), min_ess_tail_pop = min(pop$ess_tail),
    max_rhat_site = max(st$rhat), min_ess_bulk_site = min(st$ess_bulk), min_ess_tail_site = min(st$ess_tail),
    n_site_pars = nrow(st), n_site_fail = st[rhat > 1.01 | ess_bulk < 400 | ess_tail < 400, .N],
    acc_mu = range(acc$mu), acc_sigma = range(acc$sd),
    acc_decay = unlist(acc$decay), acc_eir = unlist(acc$eir),
    cor_abs = abs(r),
    halflife = q3(ps$mu_d_natural * log(2)), sigma_d = q3(ps$sigma_d))
}
FIT_GRID <- mcmc_variants()
mcmc_fits <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(seq_len(nrow(FIT_GRID)), function(i)
  mcmc_fit_summary(FIT_GRID$rdt_sensitivity[i], FIT_GRID$sigma_d_prior_sd[i])))
```

```{r mcmc-summary, results = "asis"}
fit_label <- function(f) sprintf("RDT %d\\%%, $\\sigma_d$ prior SD %s%s", round(100 * f$rdt_sensitivity), format(f$sigma_d_prior_sd),
                                 if (is_main_rdt_sensitivity(f$rdt_sensitivity) && is_main_sigma_sd(f$sigma_d_prior_sd)) " (main)" else "")
main <- Filter(function(f) is_main_rdt_sensitivity(f$rdt_sensitivity) && is_main_sigma_sd(f$sigma_d_prior_sd), mcmc_fits)[[1]]
all_max_rhat <- max(vapply(mcmc_fits, function(f) max(f$max_rhat_pop, f$max_rhat_site), 0))
all_min_ess  <- min(vapply(mcmc_fits, function(f) min(f$min_ess_bulk_pop, f$min_ess_bulk_site), 0))
all_min_esst <- min(vapply(mcmc_fits, function(f) min(f$min_ess_tail_pop, f$min_ess_tail_site), 0))
all_fail     <- sum(vapply(mcmc_fits, `[[`, 0, "n_site_fail"))
loose <- Filter(function(f) !is_main_sigma_sd(f$sigma_d_prior_sd), mcmc_fits)

mcmc_txt <- sprintf(paste0(
  "We ran %d chains per fit, each with %s warm-up and %s retained iterations (no thinning), giving %s posterior draws. ",
  "All %d fits converged: across population and site parameters, the maximum $\\hat{R}$ was %s and the minimum bulk and tail ESS were %s and %s, ",
  "and %d of %s site parameters failed $\\hat{R} \\leq 1.01$ or ESS $\\geq$ 400. ",
  "In the main fit, acceptance rates were %s--%s for $\\mu_d$, %s--%s for $\\sigma_d$, median %s (range %s--%s) for site decay and median %s (range %s--%s) for site EIR. ",
  "Within sites, the posterior correlation between log decay and log EIR had median $|r|$ %s (IQR %s--%s); %d of %d sites exceeded 0.5 and %d exceeded 0.8. ",
  "The population half-life was robust to the $\\sigma_d$ prior (%s days in the main fit; %s), but $\\sigma_d$ was not (%s in the main fit; %s), ",
  "so the between-site spread in the main analysis is largely set by its prior."),
  main$n_chains, int(main$n_warmup), int(main$n_iter), int(main$n_draws),
  length(mcmc_fits), fmt(all_max_rhat, 3), int(round(all_min_ess)), int(round(all_min_esst)),
  all_fail, int(sum(vapply(mcmc_fits, `[[`, 0, "n_site_pars"))),
  fmt(main$acc_mu[1], 2), fmt(main$acc_mu[2], 2), fmt(main$acc_sigma[1], 2), fmt(main$acc_sigma[2], 2),
  fmt(median(main$acc_decay), 2), fmt(min(main$acc_decay), 2), fmt(max(main$acc_decay), 2),
  fmt(median(main$acc_eir), 2), fmt(min(main$acc_eir), 2), fmt(max(main$acc_eir), 2),
  fmt(median(main$cor_abs), 2), fmt(quantile(main$cor_abs, 0.25), 2), fmt(quantile(main$cor_abs, 0.75), 2),
  sum(main$cor_abs > 0.5), main$n_sites, sum(main$cor_abs > 0.8),
  ci(main$halflife[1], main$halflife[2], main$halflife[3], 1),
  paste(vapply(loose, function(f) sprintf("%s with prior SD %s", ci(f$halflife[1], f$halflife[2], f$halflife[3], 1), format(f$sigma_d_prior_sd)), ""), collapse = " and "),
  ci(main$sigma_d[1], main$sigma_d[2], main$sigma_d[3], 2),
  paste(vapply(loose, function(f) sprintf("%s with prior SD %s", ci(f$sigma_d[1], f$sigma_d[2], f$sigma_d[3], 2), format(f$sigma_d_prior_sd)), ""), collapse = " and "))
cat("```latex\n", mcmc_txt, "\n```\n\n", sep = "")

# Supplementary table: one row per fit. Half-life and sigma_P posteriors per
# fit are already in tab:post and tab:sigma_variance, so this table holds the
# convergence diagnostics only (keeps it inside the page width).
tab_mcmc <- tex_float_table(
  "l l c c c c c",
  c(" & & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\textbf{Population}} & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{\\textbf{Site}} \\\\",
    "\\cmidrule(lr){3-4} \\cmidrule(l){5-7}",
    "\\textbf{\\makecell[l]{RDT\\\\sensitivity}} & \\textbf{\\makecell[l]{$\\sigma_P$\\\\prior SD}} & \\textbf{Max $\\hat{R}$} & \\textbf{\\makecell{Min ESS\\\\(bulk / tail)}} & \\textbf{Max $\\hat{R}$} & \\textbf{\\makecell{Min ESS\\\\(bulk / tail)}} & \\textbf{Failing} \\\\"),
  vapply(mcmc_fits, function(f) sprintf("%d\\%% & %s%s & %s & %s / %s & %s & %s / %s & %d / %s \\\\",

    if (is_main_rdt_sensitivity(f$rdt_sensitivity) && is_main_sigma_sd(f$sigma_d_prior_sd)) " (main)" else "",
    fmt(f$max_rhat_pop, 3), int(round(f$min_ess_bulk_pop)), int(round(f$min_ess_tail_pop)),
    fmt(f$max_rhat_site, 3), int(round(f$min_ess_bulk_site)), int(round(f$min_ess_tail_site)),
    f$n_site_fail, int(f$n_site_pars)), ""),
  sprintf("Convergence diagnostics for each MCMC fit (%d chains, each with %s warm-up and %s retained iterations). ESS = effective sample size. Failing = site parameters with $\\hat{R} > 1.01$ or bulk or tail ESS $<$ 400.",
          main$n_chains, int(main$n_warmup), int(main$n_iter)),
  "tab:mcmc_diagnostics")
cat("```latex\n", paste(tab_mcmc, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

# Guidance figure: RDT interpretation (the manuscript's figures/nmcp_guidance.tex)

FDR = P(microscopy- | RDT+) for febrile children, from the step 2 regression (population-level predictions, `re_formula = NA`). Every figure number is standardised over the febrile children in the regression data: each child keeps their own prevalence, timing and other covariates unless the number fixes them, and FDR is the ratio of summed probabilities, $\sum P(\mathrm{LM-}, \mathrm{RDT+}) / \sum P(\mathrm{RDT+})$, within each posterior draw, so it is the share of febrile RDT-positive children who are microscopy-negative. Ranges are the lowest to highest posterior mean across the 2 SMC $\times$ 3 *pfhrp2* deletion-risk strata. Ages: 12 and 59 months (59, not 60, keeps the older age inside the survey range of 6-59 months).

```{r nmcp-figure, results = "asis"}
# Febrile children the regression was fitted to, collapsed to unique covariate
# rows with counts so each posterior_epred() call is small (predictions
# ignore survid with re_formula = NA, so rows that share covariates are
# identical).
FIG_AGES <- c(young = 12, old = 59)   # months; "Age 1 year" and "Age 5 years" in the figure
FIG_VARS <- c("sr_rdt_cat", "hrp2_risk", "has_smc", "during_or_after_peak", "care_or_act", "fever", "age_c")
feb <- as.data.table(reg_fit$data)[fever == 1, ..FIG_VARS]
age_mean <- mean(reg_data$age_months)   # centring used when the model was fitted (prepare_brms_full_data())

# Standardised FDR draws: set the `fix` covariates for every febrile child,
# keep everything else as observed, then sum probabilities within each draw.
fdr_std <- function(fix = list()) {
  d <- copy(feb)
  for (v in names(fix)) {
    val <- fix[[v]]
    if (is.factor(d[[v]])) val <- factor(val, levels = levels(d[[v]]))
    set(d, j = v, value = val)
  }
  d <- d[, .(n = .N), by = FIG_VARS]
  d[, survid := reg_fit$data$survid[1]]   # ignored: re_formula = NA
  ep <- brms::posterior_epred(reg_fit, newdata = d, re_formula = NA)
  w  <- d$n
  np <- ep[, , "n_p", drop = FALSE][, , 1, drop = TRUE]; pp <- ep[, , "p_p", drop = FALSE][, , 1, drop = TRUE]
  if (is.null(dim(np))) { np <- matrix(np, ncol = 1); pp <- matrix(pp, ncol = 1) }
  100 * as.vector((np %*% w) / ((np + pp) %*% w))
}
q_fdr <- function(x) c(mean = mean(x), lo = quantile(x, 0.025, names = FALSE), hi = quantile(x, 0.975, names = FALSE))

# SMC x deletion-risk strata
hrp2_lv <- levels(reg_fit$data$hrp2_risk)
strata  <- CJ(has_smc = c(0L, 1L), hrp2_risk = hrp2_lv, sorted = FALSE)
pct_rng <- function(x) sprintf("%s--%s\\%%", fmt(min(x), 0), fmt(max(x), 0))

# 1. Headline: all febrile children as observed, plus the SMC x deletion-risk range
fig_all <- q_fdr(fdr_std())
fig_strata <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(strata)), function(i)
  as.list(c(strata[i], q_fdr(fdr_std(list(has_smc = strata$has_smc[i], hrp2_risk = strata$hrp2_risk[i])))))))

# 2. Clinician table: care x age, each cell ranged over the six strata
fig_cells <- rbindlist(lapply(c(0L, 1L), function(care) rbindlist(lapply(names(FIG_AGES), function(a) {
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(strata)), function(i) {
    r <- q_fdr(fdr_std(list(care_or_act = care, age_c = FIG_AGES[[a]] - age_mean,
                            has_smc = strata$has_smc[i], hrp2_risk = strata$hrp2_risk[i])))
    data.table(care = care, age = a, has_smc = strata$has_smc[i], hrp2_risk = strata$hrp2_risk[i],
               mean = r[["mean"]], lo = r[["lo"]], hi = r[["hi"]])
  }))
}))))
fig_tab <- fig_cells[, .(min = min(mean), max = max(mean)), by = .(care, age)]
# Bold where even the lowest stratum has at least half of RDT+ children
# microscopy-negative ("recent infection at least as likely as current")
fig_tab[, rng := sprintf("%s--%s\\%%", fmt(min, 0), fmt(max, 0))]   # row-wise (pct_rng() collapses a vector)
fig_tab[, cell := fifelse(round(min) >= 50, sprintf("\\textbf{%s}", rng), rng)]
fig_crihw <- median(c((fig_cells$hi - fig_cells$lo) / 2, (fig_strata$hi - fig_strata$lo) / 2))

# ---- Keys for the figure (cited with \nm{} in nmcp_guidance.tex) ----------
num("fig.fdr.fever.mean", fig_all[["mean"]], 0)
num("fig.fdr.fever.lo", fig_all[["lo"]], 0); num("fig.fdr.fever.hi", fig_all[["hi"]], 0)
num("fig.fdr.fever.rng", pct_rng(fig_strata$mean))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(fig_tab))) {
  r <- fig_tab[i]; k <- sprintf("fig.fdr.care%d.%s", r$care, r$age)
  num(paste0(k, ".rng"), r$rng); num(paste0(k, ".cell"), r$cell)
  # Share of RDT+ estimated to be current infection (100 - FDR), for the
  # clinician table: "Share ... estimated to reflect current infection".
  num(sprintf("fig.ppv.care%d.%s.rng", r$care, r$age),
      sprintf("%s--%s\\%%", fmt(100 - r$max, 0), fmt(100 - r$min, 0)))
}
num("fig.fdr.crihw", fig_crihw, 0)
num_int("fig.age.young.months", FIG_AGES[["young"]]); num_int("fig.age.old.months", FIG_AGES[["old"]])
if (any(fig_tab[care == 1, round(min) < 50]) || any(fig_tab[care == 0, round(min) >= 50]))
  note("Guidance figure: bolding no longer follows care (bold = every stratum >= 50%%); check the callout wording.")

cat(sprintf("Febrile children: %s (%s unique covariate rows). Headline FDR %s%% (95%% CrI %s--%s%%), range across SMC x deletion-risk strata %s.\n\n",
            int(nrow(feb)), int(nrow(unique(feb))), fmt(fig_all[["mean"]], 0), fmt(fig_all[["lo"]], 0), fmt(fig_all[["hi"]], 0),
            gsub("\\\\", "", pct_rng(fig_strata$mean))))
print(knitr::kable(fig_strata[, .(SMC = has_smc, `Deletion risk` = hrp2_risk, `FDR %` = round(mean, 1), lo = round(lo, 1), hi = round(hi, 1))],
                   caption = "Headline FDR by stratum (febrile children)"))
print(knitr::kable(dcast(fig_tab[, .(Care = fifelse(care == 1, "Care in past 2 weeks", "No care"),
                                     age = sprintf("%d months", FIG_AGES[age]), cell = gsub("\\\\textbf\\{|\\}|\\\\", "", cell))],
                         Care ~ age, value.var = "cell"), caption = "Clinician table (bold in figure when every stratum >= 50%)"))
cat(sprintf("\nMedian 95%% CrI half-width: %s percentage points.\n", fmt(fig_crihw, 1)))
```

# Numbers file for Overleaf

All numbers and tables above, keyed for `\nm{key}` in the manuscript, written to one file: `results/numbers.tex`. Keys are `<section>.<quantity>[.<variant>].<stat>`; intervals give `.med`, `.lo`, `.hi`, `.ci` ("m (lo--hi)") and, for the regression, `.pci` ("m\% (lo--hi)"). Variant tags: `se080`/`se090`/`se100` (RDT sensitivity), `sd001`/`sd005`/`sd010` ($\sigma_d$ prior SD). Unsuffixed keys are the main fit (RDT sensitivity `r SE`, prior SD `r SIGMA_D_PRIOR_SD_MAIN`).

```{r numbers, results = "asis"}
# NUMBERS is created fresh when numbers_fns.R is sourced (load chunk); the
# nmcp-figure chunk above has already added the fig.* keys.
prev_key <- function(x) ifelse(grepl("^<", x), "lo", ifelse(grepl("^>", x), "hi", "mid"))

# ---- Data stream ----------------------------------------------------------
num_int("data.paired.surveys", N_paired_surveys); num_int("data.paired.countries", N_paired_countries)
num_int("data.reg.surveys", N_reg_surveys);       num_int("data.reg.countries", N_reg_countries)
# Years as plain integers: num_int() adds a thousands separator ("2,024")
num("data.reg.year.start", sprintf("%d", as.integer(reg_years[1]))); num("data.reg.year.end", sprintf("%d", as.integer(reg_years[2])))
num_int("data.reg.countries.esa", n_reg_countries_region("ESA"))
num_int("data.reg.countries.wca", n_reg_countries_region("WCA"))
num_int("data.reg.indiv", N_reg_individuals)

# ---- Regression (percentage points) ---------------------------------------
num("reg.fpr.prevhi.rng", rng(fpr_prev_hi$diff_mean)); num("reg.fpr.prevmid.rng", rng(fpr_prev_mid$diff_mean))
# High vs slight deletion risk, by prevalence level, as a reduction (sign flipped)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(fpr_high_del))) {
  r <- fpr_high_del[i]; lv <- prev_key(gsub(".*prevalence: ([^)]*)\\).*", "\\1", r$covariate))
  num_ci(sprintf("reg.fpr.highdel.%s", lv), -r$diff_mean, -r$diff_hi, -r$diff_lo, d = 2, pct = TRUE)
}
num_int("reg.fpr.highdel.nsig", nrow(fpr_high_sig))
bin_key <- c(Fever = "fever", SMC = "smc", Care = "care", Timing = "timing", Age = "age")
for (k in names(bin_key)) {
  r <- bin_fpr[key == k]; num_ci(sprintf("reg.fpr.%s", bin_key[[k]]), r$diff_mean, r$diff_lo, r$diff_hi, d = 2, pct = TRUE)
  # FDR effects as magnitudes; the text says whether each raised or lowered the FDR
  r <- bin_fdr[key == k]; a <- abs(c(r$diff_lo, r$diff_hi))

}

# Average marginal effects (fpfn_ame.RDS; method in results/ame_method.txt), in

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ame))) {

}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(map_nat))) {

}

# ---- Fixed-effect selection (appendix Table tab:elpd and the text above it) --
# From results/table_loo_fixed_effect_selection.csv, written by
# src/2_regression/fixed_effect_selection.R Section B.
elpd_csv <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "table_loo_fixed_effect_selection.csv")
if (file.exists(elpd_csv)) {
  elpd <- fread(elpd_csv)
  tex_signed <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(round(x, d) < 0, paste0("$-$", fmt(abs(x), d)), fmt(x, d))
  tex_comma  <- function(x) gsub(",", "{,}", x)
  tex_label  <- function(x) {
    x <- sub("^- ", "$-$ ", x)
    x <- gsub("pfhrp2", "\\\\textit{pfhrp2}", x)
    x <- gsub(" x ", " $\\\\times$ ", x)
    sub("\\(- region, - year\\)", "($-$ region, $-$ year)", x)
  }
  elpd_row <- function(m) {
    r <- elpd[model == m]
    sprintf("%s & %s (%s) & %s \\\\", tex_label(r$label), tex_comma(tex_signed(r$elpd)), fmt(r$elpd_se),
            if (m == "full") "0" else sprintf("%s (%s)", tex_signed(r$delta_elpd), fmt(r$delta_elpd_se)))
  }
  reduced <- setdiff(elpd$model, c("full", "main_model"))
  reduced <- reduced[order(-elpd[match(reduced, model), delta_elpd])]   # smallest loss first
  # The whole tabular, so the alignment never depends on how \nm expands
  num_table("tab.elpd", c("\\begin{tabular}{lrr}", "\\toprule",
                          "Model & ELPD (SE) & $\\Delta$ELPD vs full (SE) \\\\", "\\midrule",
                          elpd_row("full"), "\\addlinespace", vapply(reduced, elpd_row, ""),
                          "\\addlinespace", elpd_row("main_model"), "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}"))
  # "Delta ELPD -839.0, SE 40.1" for each model, cited in the text
  for (m in setdiff(elpd$model, "full")) {
    r <- elpd[model == m]
    num(sprintf("elpd.%s", gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", m)),
        sprintf("$\\Delta$ELPD %s, SE %s", tex_signed(r$delta_elpd), fmt(r$delta_elpd_se)))
    num(sprintf("elpd.%s.loss", gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", m)), -r$delta_elpd, 1)
    num(sprintf("elpd.%s.se", gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", m)), r$delta_elpd_se, 1)
  }
  num("elpd.maxk", max(elpd$max_pareto_k), 2)
} else {
  note("No %s; run src/2_regression/fixed_effect_selection.R (COMPARE = TRUE).", elpd_csv)
}

# ---- Guidance figure (the manuscript's figures/nmcp_guidance_body.tex) ----
# The figure's \nmfallback{res.*} defaults are replaced by these values.
key_val <- function(k) get(k, envir = NUMBERS)
signed  <- function(k) sprintf("$-$%s", key_val(k))   # AME magnitudes are stored unsigned; the figure shows a decrease
num("res.ratio.median", median(ratio)); num("res.ratio.iqr", sprintf("%s--%s", fmt(quantile(ratio, 0.25)), fmt(quantile(ratio, 0.75))))
num("res.ratio.min", min(slopes$slope)); num("res.ratio.max", max(slopes$slope))
num_int("res.n.surveys.calib", N_cal_surveys)
num("res.fpr.natl.mdg", key_val("reg.map.madagascar.fpr.mean")); num("res.fdr.natl.ken", key_val("reg.map.kenya.fdr.mean"))
num("res.fdr.min", map_ext$fdr$min$fdr); num("res.fdr.max", map_ext$fdr$max$fdr)
num_int("res.ppv.min", 100 - map_ext$fdr$max$fdr); num_int("res.ppv.max", 100 - map_ext$fdr$min$fdr)
num("res.ame.fdr.delhigh", key_val("reg.ame.fdr.highdel.ci"))
num("res.ame.fdr.prev2", signed("reg.ame.fdr.prevmid.med")); num("res.ame.fdr.prev3", signed("reg.ame.fdr.prevhi.med"))
num("res.ame.fdr.smc", key_val("reg.ame.fdr.smc.ci"))
num("res.ame.fdr.care", key_val("reg.ame.fdr.care.ci")); num("res.ame.fdr.age", key_val("reg.ame.fdr.age.ci"))
num("res.hl.pop", key_val("post.hl.ci")); num("res.hl.pred", sprintf("%s--%s", key_val("post.newsite.lo"), key_val("post.newsite.hi")))
if (!is.null(ppc$marg_all)) {
  num_int("res.cov.msim", ppc$marg_all[["rdtj"]]); num_int("res.cov.wu", ppc$marg_all[["rdtwu"]])
  num("res.cov.ratio", ppc$marg_all[["rdtj"]] / ppc$marg_all[["rdtwu"]])
}

# ---- Tables ---------------------------------------------------------------
num_table("tab.post", tab)
num_table("tab.sigma", tab_sig)
num_table("tab.sites", tab_sites)
if (exists("tab_emu")) num_table("tab.emuflags", tab_emu)
num_table("tab.mcmc", tab_mcmc)

# The manuscript lives outside this repository. When HRP2_MANUSCRIPT_DIR
# points to a local copy, numbers.tex holds only the keys it cites (\nm{key}
# in any .tex file there) and a cited key the code does not produce is
# reported in Checks; otherwise numbers.tex holds every registered key.
cited <- NULL
if (!is.na(MANUSCRIPT_DIR) && dir.exists(MANUSCRIPT_DIR)) {
  cited <- manuscript_keys(MANUSCRIPT_DIR)
  # A folder without .tex files (e.g. before the sources are added) would
  # otherwise give an empty numbers.tex
  if (length(cited) == 0) { note("No \\nm{} keys found in %s; numbers.tex holds every registered key.", MANUSCRIPT_DIR); cited <- NULL }
  missing_keys <- setdiff(cited, ls(NUMBERS))
  if (length(missing_keys)) note("Keys cited in the manuscript but not produced: %s", paste(missing_keys, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  note("HRP2_MANUSCRIPT_DIR not set; numbers.tex holds every registered key.")
}
numbers_path <- write_numbers(file.path(OUT_DIR, "numbers.tex"),
                              sprintf("RDT sensitivity %s, fit %s", SE, MCMC_OUT_DIR), keep = cited)
cat(sprintf("Wrote %d keys to `%s`.\n\n", length(ls(NUMBERS)), numbers_path))
keys <- sort(ls(NUMBERS)); vals <- vapply(keys, function(k) get(k, envir = NUMBERS), "")
print(knitr::kable(data.table(number_key = keys, value = unname(ifelse(startsWith(keys, "tab."), "(table)", vals))), caption = "Registered numbers"))
```

# Checks

```{r checks, results = "asis"}
if (length(checks) == 0) cat("No problems found.\n") else cat(paste0("- ", checks, "\n"), sep = "")
```
